blocks.text: With a growing global market presence and roots in Japanese design, JINS continues to strengthen its presence in the Philippines with the opening of its 10th store at Ayala Malls Manila Bay, located on the mall’s second floor. Marking a significant step in the brand’s local development, the opening signals a bigger vision for JINS Philippines as it accelerates its nationwide expansion, bringing Tokyo-designed eyewear closer to more Filipino communities. Born and curated in Tokyo, JINS has built its reputation on making quality glasses more accessible while addressing the everyday needs of modern consumers.
